title: Interleaved chunk replay suite for streaming ergonomics and retry correctness
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a deterministic test suite and fixture format for exercising streaming APIs across our SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go). The focus is to reproduce real-world network behaviors at the chunk/frame level: interleaved chunks, partial frames, abrupt connection pauses, replayed transient 502/504 errors mid-stream, and reordered chunk delivery. The suite will validate SDK behaviors for: retry semantics, idempotent resume, backpressure and flow-control ergonomics, cancellation propagation, and client-side buffering policies. Deliverables: a new cassette format (interleaved-chunk), a mockserver playback driver, cross-language test runners, and CI contract checks against a staging Redwood API proxy.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible cassette format (v1) that encodes chunk boundaries, byte offsets, timing jitter, and simulated HTTP/TCP transient errors
Mockserver playback driver added to infra that can inject pauses, partial frames, and chunk reordering deterministically
End-to-end tests added for Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs that fail on regressions for: incorrect retry attempts, duplicate tokens on resume, client hangs on slow producers, and failed cancellations
CI gate: PRs touching SDK streaming code must run the interleaved-chunk suite in headless mode; flakiness rate < 1% over 50 runs
Documentation and examples showing how to record a real session and mutate a cassette to create edge cases
implementation_notes: Cassette format: JSONL with ordered events. Each event encodes {timestamp_ms, direction, connection_id, chunk_id, start_byte, end_byte, body_hex, error_code(optional), pause_ms(optional)}
Mockserver: extend existing SDK mock proxy to support 'tcp-mode' playback that replays body bytes in configured chunk sizes and timings. Add deterministic RNG seed support for CI reproducibility

SDK test runners: add a small harness in each repo (python/tests/stream_replay, js/tests/stream_replay, go/tests/stream_replay) that wraps the SDK's streaming iterator and asserts semantics (resume idempotency, single-on-complete, error propagation)
Failure detection: add contract assertions on token-level continuity and on number of retry attempts emitted by SDK telemetry APIs
Performance: ensure playback driver can run 200 parallel cassettes in CI without saturating runners (use lightweight TCP multiplexing)
Backward compatibility: new cassette v1 reader should accept older 'full-response' cassettes and convert on-the-fly for legacy tests
test_plan: Record 10 real sessions from staging that include large-generation streams and user cancellations
Create 30 mutated cassettes injecting mid-stream 502 then 200 resume, partial frame truncation, and reordering
Run cross-SDK suite nightly for a week with 100 iterations to establish baseline flakiness
Add a gate job that runs the fast subset (20 cassettes) on every PR touching streaming code
Manual QA: run designer scripts to assert UX edge cases in TypeScript example app (stream splicing, progress bars)
rollout_plan: Phase 1: merge mockserver driver and cassette v1 reader behind feature flag in SDKs
Phase 2: onboard core streaming tests to CI (non-blocking) and run for 3 days to collect flakiness metrics
Phase 3: enable gate job for PRs and require passing interleaved-chunk fast-suite
Phase 4: publish documentation and example guide for partner teams to author cassettes
